title: The thread card of a comment Tracy resolved titles its Resolved pill "Tracy marked this done" (the Comments list's words); a person's resolve still reads "Resolved by <name>"
steps: S0: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md). Site S = the WordPress test site (scv2wp.<stand domain>), P = its page origin as its comments carry it. Pick a published post id PID and its exact title T from the site's database (read only).

S1: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-044] tracy","url":"$P/","element":null}' → keep comment.id as C. api a POST /api/sites/$S/requests '{"sessionId":"reg044-<ms>","requestId":"r-<ms>","items":[{"url":"$P/","element":null,"text":"","commentId":"C"}]}' → keep requests[0].n as N.

S2: api a POST /api/sites/$S/apply '{"action":"content.update","params":{"kind":"post","id":PID,"fields":{"post_title":"T"},"apply_id":"reg044-<ms>"},"comment":N}' (the title written back unchanged). api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments and read row C.
S3: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-044] person","url":"$P/","element":null}' → keep its id as H; api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments/H/resolve.

S4: Browser as seat a: open $O/$S/?open=browser&page=/&mode=edit&comment=C; wait for [data-thread="C"]; read the title attribute and text of [data-thread="C"] [data-resolved-pill]. Then open $O/$S/?open=browser&page=/&mode=edit&comment=H; wait for [data-thread="H"]; read the same of [data-thread="H"] [data-resolved-pill].
S5: Clean up: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments/clear '{"ids":["C","H"]}'.
expect: S2: Apply answers ok:true; row C has status 'resolved' and resolvedByTracy true.

S4 (seat a in English): C's pill reads 'Resolved' with title 'Tracy marked this done' (never 'Resolved by Tracy'); H's pill reads 'Resolved' with title 'Resolved by <seat a's name>'. A seat in Vietnamese reads 'Tracy đã đánh dấu xong' on C.
evidence: After PR #822 (ADR 0025) the Comments list tagged a comment Tracy resolved 'Tracy marked this done' while its thread card's pill still said 'Resolved by Tracy' (tasks/todo-comment-people.md, raised 04/10).
fence: The card reads the server's resolvedByTracy; only that flag switches the pill's words, a person's resolve keeps 'Resolved by <name>'
